text:
maria: :rotating_light: Seeing a huge spike in alerts from inference-gateway — ~4.5k alerts in last 10m, PagerDuty noise is drowning out the important stuff. Multiple customers seeing 503/timeout errors. Opening a live thread to coordinate mitigation. Incident link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by maria • Severity: high • Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/inference-gateway-hot-path

sam: oncall here — first step: quiet the PD flood so engineers can actually triage. planning to apply a temporary dedupe + grouping rule and a short squelch on low-value noise. tagging @tony for customer impact.

tonY: tony: ACME and Nabla reported elevated 5xx and timeouts starting ~06:12 UTC. ACME notes degraded throughput on their dedicated pools. This is customer-impacting.

emily: I can update the status page once we confirm mitigation and impact window. pls ping me when we have the short blurb.

sam: applying temporary alert pipeline change now. will set dedupe window 5m and group by route+model to collapse repeats, and add token-bucket rate limit for bursts.

sam: config I'm pushing to alert-pipeline (preview):
```yaml
# temporary mitigation - applied 1890123456
- name: temp-dedupe-inference-gateway
  match: 
    source: inference-gateway
    severity: [warning, critical]
  dedupe_window: 300s        # collapse identical alerts for 5m
  group_by: ["route","model_version","customer_id"]
  rate_limit: "120/minute"  # per-group burst dampening
  note: "applied during incident; revert after postmortem"
```

sam: also adding a short squelch for noisy 429s/timeout traces from non-customer-facing internal endpoints: `/internal/*`

sam: CLI command used to apply squelch:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.redwood.ai/v1/alerts/squelch" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"scope":"inference-gateway","match":{"route":"/internal/*"},"duration_seconds":3600,"reason":"reduce PD noise during mitigation"}'
```

devops-bot: Applied squelch id=sq-84f2 • dedupe rule applied temp-dedupe-inference-gateway • dashboards updated (inference-gateway/traffic-overview)

maria: 👍 thanks @sam. can you also bump the 5xx alert threshold to avoid noisy small blips? current rule triggers at 1% 5xx over 1m which is too sensitive for traffic pattern bursts. suggest 5% over 5m for now.

sam: done — updated alert threshold (old: 1%/1m -> new: 5%/5m). Query used in grafana rule: `sum(rate(inference_gateway_5xx_total[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_gateway_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05`

sam: putting a note in the alert config: `todo: revisit threshold with historical traffic slices.`

tonY: confirming ACME's telemetry — errors down from 12% -> 3% after squelch + routing fix they applied on their side. They still saw elevated latency ~200ms above baseline.

emily: status page draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and timeouts affecting inference-gateway. Mitigations applied to reduce alert noise and stabilize traffic; we're tracking customer impact and will provide an update at 30m." Want to post?

maria: post it. include note that PD alerts are reduced and engineering is triaging root cause.

sam: quick heads-up on root cause hypothesis: a suddenly higher tail-latency from a downstream KV cache (kvpool-3) causing retries and amplified error signals. working with infra to confirm.

sam: I've created a temporary dashboard panel (link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/inference-gw) showing top routes by 5xx, model versions, and per-customer error rate. bookmarking it for oncall.

maria: seeing overall alert count drop ~85% after dedupe + squelch 😌 still keeping the rules in place for now.

tonY: ACME on phone — appreciates the quick mitigation. they asked for an RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

sam: next steps I will:
- keep temp dedupe for next 2 hours
- add durable alert rule change proposal (rate-based + group-by route/model)
- instrument an additional metric: `inference.gateway.kv_retry_rate` to track downstream cache behavior

maria: action items / owners: 
- sam: follow up durable alerting changes, propose PR to alert repo by EOD
- devops: add alerting cookbook entry for temporary squelch/dedupe play (owner: sam/devops)
- emily: postmortem & customer comms draft (owner: emily)
- tony: coordinate ACME follow-up and impacted customer list

emily: noted — I'll start the postmortem skeleton and ping legal for customer comms template.

sam: I will also schedule a short blameless post-incident review tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

maria: thanks all. leaving this thread open until we revert the squelch and confirm root cause. if any further escalation, @pagerduty -> priority.

devops-bot: Reminder: temp squelch expires in 55 minutes (id=sq-84f2). You can extend with `curl .../squelch/extend` if needed.

maria: marking this thread as mitigation-in-progress. will add final timings and link to postmortem once complete. :white_check_mark:
